title: Pilobol.us P3-06: rehearse import, export and byte parity on the proof backend with the real Git content
description:
## Goal
Rehearse the whole content path on the isolated cms-proof backend with the REAL Pilobol.us Git content: import-markus dry run and apply, S3 media upload, export-published, reader build from the export, byte diff against the live site. Production is not touched.

## Context (FACT, measured 2026-10-06 with develop 4a423c3 and an in-memory FakeAuthoringClient + DirMediaStore, no AWS)
- Source = git archive of AnthusAI/Pilobol.us origin/main web/content: 21 tracked .md files (10 articles, a-fungus-among-us, 3 drafts in drafts/, 7 pages in effects/ incl. effects/index.md) plus 65 tracked asset files. The "23 files" figure of PR #115 counted the two build-generated, gitignored listing pages (web/content/index.md and web/content/articles/index.md); the reader build regenerates them from the articles, so they must NOT be imported.
- Dry run/apply result: errors 0, created 21, published 18, drafts 3 (--draft-dirs drafts=articles), mediaUploaded 13 (3,096,881 bytes in total, largest 700 KB), readerOwnedAssets 56 (JS/CSS/HTML and unreferenced images stay in the reader repo), aliases 0, notInSource 0.
- Export (published): 18 items, 12 media, 0 redirects (_papyrus/redirects.json empty). Reader build from export + no-clobber overlay of the Git assets dir = 94 files, identical to the live site (diff -rq empty; live fetch 94/94).
- importer: front matter and body stored verbatim; idempotent; never overwrites CMS edits without --force; validates everything before writing. Aliases: none needed (live has no redirect rules; Amplify customRules only the catch-all 404-200).
- Auth for operators today: papyrus auth refresh-jwt reads the backend's PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET from SSM and mints a short-lived JWT (writes allowed). That is reading a secret: needs Ryan's yes each time; never print the token.

## Exact steps
1. Scratch: git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us scratch/pilo; mkdir scratch/src; (cd scratch/pilo && git archive origin/main web/content | tar -x -C ../src) so only tracked files are used.
2. Install: python3.12 -m venv scratch/venv; pip install "papyrus-newsroom[markus,newsroom]==<pin as PEP 440>" (today 1.0.0.dev8).
3. Point the CLI at the PROOF backend only: use the proof branch's amplify_outputs.json (npx ampx generate outputs --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch cms-proof --out-dir scratch/proof). Mint the JWT (papyrus auth refresh-jwt --write-env scratch/.env with PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET_SSM_PARAM set to the cms-proof path) after Ryan's yes. Stop if the endpoint in use equals the production endpoint (compare ids, never print secrets).
4. Dry run: papyrus content import-markus --content-dir scratch/src/web/content --draft-dirs drafts=articles --dry-run --json. Review: expect exactly the numbers above. Anything else: stop and report.
5. Apply (Ryan yes): the same command with --apply and --bucket <proof bucket from the proof outputs>. Re-run: expect created 0, updated 0, mediaUnchanged 13, zero writes.
6. aws s3 ls s3://<proof bucket>/media/ --recursive | wc -l = 13; scan-count Item 21, PublishedItem 18, MediaAsset 13 on the proof tables.
7. Export: papyrus content export-published --out scratch/export --clean --json (expect items 18, media 12, redirects 0). Assemble in a scratch clone: replace web/content with the export, then cp -Rn the Git web/content/assets/. into it (no clobber); build with web/build_via_papyrus.py; compare with the parity harness: verify-parity.py --dist ... --live https://pilobol.us --narration = 94/94 and 11/11.
8. Edit test: in the proof /newsroom editor open one article, make no change, Save: item unchanged (content hash). Do not edit text.

## Acceptance checks
- Numbers match step 4; second apply is a no-op; export + build = 94/94 identical to live; narration hashes equal.
- Production counts still 0 and the production endpoint never used.

## Rollback
Proof data is disposable: delete the proof branch (the CMS proof ticket's rollback) or leave it. Nothing production changed.

## Risks
- publishedAt may be null for date strings like "Sunday, September 6, 2026" (kept verbatim in front matter; the reader reads front matter, so output is unaffected; the newsroom list order may differ).
- If the importer or exporter changes between the pin used here and the one used for production, re-run this ticket's numbers on the production pin.

## Needs Ryan
JWT mint approval for the proof backend; yes to apply.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.

comments.text: CLOSED (Ryan 2026-10-06): Pilobol.us is pre-production, backend is empty, new apps are created from the template. A rehearsal on an isolated proof backend only controlled risk to a live site. Its useful part (import dry run, apply, byte-diff of export) is merged into the import ticket (PPY-d9194c).

right_now_summary: The rehearsal is merged into the import ticket, and no production resources were touched.
